title: Mobility patterns: NaN/inf configs pass validation and poison positions
description: All validation uses bare comparisons which are False for NaN: speed_m_s=.nan -> every position becomes (nan,nan) silently (mobility.py:442/646); NaN/inf area_bounds -> NaN center via inf*0 in ratio math (:256-277, :528-538); ManhattanGrid spacing_m=.nan or inf bounds raises ValueError/OverflowError from _grid_size inside step() (:794) instead of the constructor, violating the construct-time-rejection contract. Fix: math.isfinite() checks in all four pattern constructors; compute grid extent at construction. Tests: .nan/.inf rejection for every config field.
